description: Pronunciation test cases for American English
notes: American English uses IPA notation. Key phonological features tested: rhotic r, vowel reduction, stress patterns, consonant clusters.

rhotic_r.notes: American English has rhotic r in all positions, unlike British English

vowel_reduction.description: Reduction of vowels in unstressed syllables
vowel_reduction.notes: Unstressed vowels often reduce to schwa [ə]

stress_patterns.notes: Stress patterns are critical for pronunciation

th_sounds.notes: English has both /θ/ (voiceless) and /ð/ (voiced) as distinct phonemes
